Analysis.title: Exclusive Analysis
Analysis.description: Analyze your current portfolio against Profounda's latest signals and generate specific buy, sell, increase, reduce, and stop-loss recommendations.
Analysis.intro: Enter your current holdings, cost basis, number of shares, and remaining cash. The system will calculate the adjustments needed to align your portfolio with the latest target allocation. Fractional shares are supported.
Analysis.loginToViewAll: Sign up or log in to view the full analysis

results.title: Portfolio Analysis
results.note: The stop-loss price is estimated using the current risk-management rule (approximately -15%). Holdings that are not in the current target portfolio may be recommended for exit. This does not indicate a bearish view; it means the current consensus signal has shifted to other securities. The analysis is for research and informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice.
